target.statement: NMI score of KCC on the Lymphoma dataset is 0.778 (Table 1, row Lymphoma, column KCC).

compute.basis: KCC on 96 points requires only an n×n kernel matrix (n=96) and ADMM iterations; the paper reports no GPU need for this size, and the dataset is small and publicly available.

blockers: Hyperparameters (σ1, σ2, ρ, γ) are not fully specified in the paper; code may need tuning to match the reported NMI.
The exact preprocessing (standardization) and weight construction details are only partially described.
title: A New Framework for Convex Clustering in Kernel Spaces: Finite Sample Bounds, Consistency and Performance Insights
